title: Jesus Heals a Blind Man
reflectionQuestion: Bartimaeus called and called, and Jesus stopped just for him. What is something you would most love to thank Jesus for?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles, secondary/short-only). JOY/gratitude/wonder; bright daylight register (texture variety per feedback_texture_diversity) + NT balance. Blindness handled gently (no distress dwelt on); the heart of it is persistence ('called even louder' when shushed) and the joy of healing. Indelible image = the FIRST thing Bartimaeus sees with new eyes is Jesus' smiling face. Distinct from other healings (1806 Jairus = raising a girl). Routes a child who wants to be heard / keeps asking -> Jesus hears the one voice in the crowd. 'I want to see' kept literal + simple; ends on following Jesus, thanking God. 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_MIRIAM_JOYFUL (lively, celebratory) -- fits the joy of seeing; keeps the JOY register alive (feedback_kid_four_registers).
